name: Stages
description: The Mutational Stages mark the Maw's ascent into true power. Ascending to a higher Stage expands its capacity, allowing it to bind more numerous and potent Mutations, while empowering those already etched into its form. To unlock each Stage, you must claim the essence of a specific Boss. Every hunter who wounds it while carrying the Maw, with any weapon, shares in the feast. When the Maw ascends, a title and a rush of soul fire announce it.
